description: Tuning for the automation engine: dispatch limits, drain behaviour, retention and payload limits.

fields.description: Stop dispatching automations site-wide. Queued rows are left untouched.
fields.label: Disable Automations

fields.description: How many times an automation may trigger another before the chain is refused.
fields.label: Maximum Recursion Depth

fields.description: Consecutive failures after which a flow is auto-disabled and its owner notified.
fields.label: Failure Threshold

fields.description: How long a claimed row may stay Running before it is assumed crashed and requeued.
fields.label: Stale Running Minutes

fields.description: How many times a claimed row is retried when its run fails outside the flow's own steps, before the row is marked Failed.
fields.label: Maximum Attempts

fields.description: Seconds a drain may keep claiming batches. 0 derives it from the queue's own timeout.
fields.label: Drain Seconds

fields.description: Rows a drain runs between commits.
fields.label: Commit Every

fields.description: Days a Failed or Skipped queue row is kept before the nightly sweep removes it.
fields.label: Queue Retention Days

fields.description: Bytes of output a step may publish to later steps. Larger output is dropped, not failed.
fields.label: Step Output Limit

fields.description: Bytes an emitted event payload may carry.
fields.label: Event Payload Limit

fields.description: Accept emit() calls for events no app registered through the automation_events hook.
fields.label: Allow Unregistered Events

name: Automation Settings
